description: task-gopher — SessionStart injects the full Haiku-delegation directive on startup, resume, clear, and post-compaction (so it survives compaction); UserPromptSubmit injects a compact reminder each turn; PreToolUse relays the directive to subagents whenever ON, rewriting Agent/Task dispatches via updatedInput so the spawned subagent's prompt carries it (SessionStart/UserPromptSubmit never fire for subagents), and in strict mode additionally blocks the first direct retrieval of each turn as a consider-task-gopher checkpoint. All are no-ops unless the plugin is toggled ON, with ONE exception: the destructive guard, which intercepts destructive and outward-facing Bash from either bundled runner (task-gopher or smart-gopher) whenever the plugin is installed — since the agent stays dispatchable while the directive is off — and asks THE USER to approve it, denying it instead when the session's permission mode means no prompt can reach a person.
